raw_text: React directives, not Next.js specific. Client Component required for: React hooks (`useState`, `useEffect`, etc.), event handlers (`onClick`, `onChange`), browser APIs (`window`, `localStorage`). https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-client Server Action, passable to Client Components: `export async function submitForm(formData: FormData) {`; inline Server Component: `export default function Page() { async function submit() {` https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-server Caching: `export async function getCachedData() { return await fetchData() }` Requires `cacheComponents: true` in `next.config.ts`. See `next-cache-components` skill. https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/directives/use-cache
